+def awaitSearchFrame (slot : Slot) (child : Child) (deadline : Nat) (read : IO α) : IO (Option α) := do
+  let task ← IO.asTask read .dedicated
+  let result ← try awaitSearch task deadline
+    catch error =>
+      retire slot child
+      discard <| IO.wait task
+      throw error
+  if result.isNone then
+    retire slot child
+    discard <| IO.wait task
+  return result
+
+/-- Only this owner advances the immutable phase. The reader publishes one

+  match ← IO.ofExcept (Research.SearchReadCut.first policy.identity policy.finishReady deadline arrived frame) with

+  | .final cutoff =>

+    unless (← IO.monoMsNow) < cutoff do return none
+    let some (reply,arrived) ← awaitSearchFrame slot child cutoff (readSearchFrame child.stdout) | return none
+    return some (toJson (← IO.ofExcept (Research.SearchReadCut.final policy.identity cutoff arrived reply)))
